findings.detail: All four manifest embed IDs match request paths and response /path identities. The article body is outside the permitted four-body/companion-entry scope; its claimed hash and offsets were not independently verified. No article block IDs are present in entry provenance. Main subsequently reports all article block IDs match. Record this as main-reported linkage, not as an independently repeated article-body verification or an unresolved claim about main recovery.

Public embed UUID, response block UUID, and internal layout block UUID are distinct. Captures 3, 4 and 5 reuse the same internal block and chart entity UUIDs. Use capture identity plus JSON Pointer, not an internal entity UUID alone, as the dataset key. Internal block/entity references resolve in all four literals; this does not establish article linkage.

All three benchmark records retain identical accessibility descriptions and labels about 2020 high-end GPU multiplayer testing, inconsistent with these laptop productivity, graphics, battery and display datasets. Treat these as stale template metadata, not benchmark definitions. Capture 2 has a generic accessibility label and an empty description; its table still contains specification data.

Capture 3 title swaps the order of AI and 16 relative to the other titles and the model rows. All four descriptions use the SFG16-A71/T variant while titles/model labels use 2026 naming. These differences do not establish hardware equivalence or a factual configuration error. Every model row list is otherwise exactly identical, including a trailing space on the Dell label.

Of 95 benchmark cells, 82 contain numeric or time strings and 13 do not: five empty strings, one direct null cell, one N/A, one WNR and five NA strings. These distinct representations are preserved. No reason for each absence, or expansion of WNR, is established by the allowed evidence. Fifteen header-corner nulls are structural and excluded from this gap count.

All non-null dataset cell values are strings, including digit strings, grouped numbers, times and specifications; there are no JSON numeric or boolean data cells, no data-cell zeros, no absent array entries and no cell objects lacking value. Configurations contain numeric/boolean values and axis zeros, which are not measurements. Reported dataset values retain source types and spellings. All 234 main-export cells match the independent parse without numeric conversion.

Scoring scales differ by test. Productivity time uses minutes:seconds and lower is favored; battery time uses hours:minutes and longer is favored. Display coverage is percent, display brightness is nits, and brightness percentages in headers are settings. Configuration strings mix dimensions, component labels and GB/TB capacities. Do not pool units or treat colon times as decimal quantities.

The review reads labels and configuration only. Numeric coercion, empty/null/NA treatment, time conversion, sorting, default sheet choice, formatting, scaling, normalization and accessibility output require renderer behavior not tested here. absoluteDistribution is true in captures 3/4 and false in 5; useSIPrefixes is false in 3/4 and true in 5. These flags cannot by themselves prove any rendered transformation or displayed result.

All counts agree: 15 matrices, 90 rows including headers, 234 cells, 16 direct null cells, 213 nonempty strings and five empty strings. Each exported cell matches its native source value and state; titles, settings and provenance also match. Of the 16 nulls, only one is a benchmark cell; seven nonempty strings are nonmeasurement markers. Rendering and ordinary extraction remain distinct acceptance questions.

limitations: No independently tested laptop performance, current offers, rendered behavior, accessibility output or live-site acceptance is claimed.
RESULT mode/status/executed fields are capture-record claims; this review independently verifies only the saved bytes, JSON and recorded identity consistency.
Article file/hash/offset provenance is inherited from entries. Reading the referenced out-of-lane article or loader was deliberately excluded.
No full recovery matrices, renderer implementation, replay artifacts, acceptance-gate changes or integration changes are produced. Main owns bounded recovery, live evidence and integration.

main_reconciliation.comparison_method: Read main artifact as inert JSON and compare every exported cell, exact string value/type, null-cell state, sheet identity, dimensions, title, settings, accessibility and body/literal provenance against the four independently parsed native bodies. No recovery code or tests were run.
main_reconciliation.meaning: Mechanical counts and values agree, but complete recovery of literal cells is not complete benchmark measurement coverage. The reported empty ordinary iframe extractions distinguish diagnostic source-data recovery from ordinary native extraction or rendering. Main-reported article linkage does not expand this independent review into a direct article-body check.

ordinaryReaderOutcome: All four standalone iframe HTML extractions remain empty; recovered chart matrices are explicit source-data evidence, not automatic reader integration
failuresAndCorrections: Initial routed proof accessed cookieContext on the route callback argument, which exposes only URL/method/signal; it failed before network. Correct the callback assertion and request accounting (routed requests increment both requests and mockedRequests).

The original per-host reservation rejected the first chart before process launch because the loader used the same host. Preserve that failed admission, then use a separate per-resource harness with duplicate URL refusal and observed two-second origin pacing.
No live request was retried. Failed proofs/admissions remain separate from the five successful native GETs.
limitations: Raw captured source and literal syntax do not establish rendered behavior or independent benchmark accuracy
Empty strings, null cells and textual missing-value tokens remain distinct; no numeric parsing, sorting, interpolation or time/unit conversion
Do not use stale accessibility descriptions as chart identity
